# 2 bed terraced house for sale

> This charming and quaint two-bedroom mid-terrace home is ideally positioned in Cork City and offers a wonderful blend of character, comfort and future potential. Dating from circa 1900 and extending to approximately 83 sq. m., the property has been exceptionally well maintained throughout and presents in excellent condition.

## Fakta
- Typ: terraced house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 2 bed
- Plocha: 83 m²
- Energetická náročnost: G
- Lokalita: 12 St. Joseph's Terrace, Gould Street, Cork City
- Cena: 265 000 €
